services.name: Book a Charter
services.desc: Choose from either S/V Artemis or S/V Nova for a pleasant, personal and private sailing experience. We specialize in weddings, proposals, birthdays, company events, ash scatterings, private dinners, and more! Have more than 6 guests? Book the entire fleet with our Buddy Boat option. Sail side by side with your very own private fleet. Booking both our monohull and catamaran is the perfect option for large parties of up to 12 guests. Together with our powerboat, Marjorie Ann, we can accommodate up to 25 guests on the water! We can customize your departure time, trip duration, and accommodate large parties of up to 25 guests. services.name: Whale Watch
services.desc: Usually departing in the early afternoon, ask us about making this an extra special Whale Watch during golden hour! Our powerboat, Marjorie Ann, departs out of Ma'alaea Harbor in search of the best conditions and most interesting and charismatic whale groups. From January through April we watch the North Pacific humpback whales that have traveled from southeast Alaska to grace the crystal clear waters of Maui! Arguably the best place to watch humpbacks in the world, there is absolutely no better way to enjoy these charismatic gentle giants than from your very own boat. Leave the crowds behind and spend time enjoying these incredible marine mammals. The Marjorie Ann is a very stable vessel

services.name: sail with us
services.desc: Join us for your own private sunset sail. Perfect for celebrating birthdays, anniversaries, proposals, bachelorette parties, quality family time, and more! Take your loved one and friends sailing on your own yacht with the help of a few crew. If desired, both S/V Artemis and S/V Nova offer a hands-on learning experience for those who wish to learn about sailing! Unlike many other companies that motor the majority of the time, we pride ourselves on sailing as much as possible. Perfect for celebrating birthdays, anniversaries, proposals, bachelorette parties, quality family time, and more! Want to spend a little extra time on the water? Add an extra hour on to your sail. services.name: Snorkel & Sail
services.desc: Only accessible by boat, you and your family can get away from large crowds and enjoy the peaceful serenity of a more private and tranquil spot on our S/V Nova. Come join us on our morning snorkel sail on S/V Nova. We begin by sailing around beautiful Ma’alaea Bay which offers offshore steady winds and calm water. We then sail over to West Maui’s breathtaking Pali cliffs or to a satellite reef off the shoreline of north Kihei for our own private snorkeling spot. Tucked beneath the cliffs are large coral outcroppings that make for beautiful underwater topography and snorkeling. We have a variety of sites along this coast which are some of Maui’s premier snorkel sites including Coral Gardens.

blurb: Guests can enjoy private sailing charters on various boats including sailing catamarans, monohulls, and powerboats.
